title: Direct upcycling of mixed plastic waste into liquid alkanes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,3910-3923
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07522J, Paper
Hongshun Ran, Run-Jie Shen, Wenyi Ni, Mengying Zheng, Xinyang Sun, Shuo Zhang, Zhi-Qiang Wang, Shourong Zheng, Xiaolei Qu, Yaxuan Jing
The direct hydrogenolysis of mixed plastics comprising polyolefins and oxygenated polymers into liquid alkanes over Ru/CeO2 + Re/CeO2 blended catalysts under solvent-free conditions is achieved.
